MigrationProvenance.Policy: Semantic copy into GRACE 4 current state; legacy sources remain byte-for-byte as migration provenance.

Principles.ContractFirst: Read or update the module contract before implementation; code implements the contract.
Principles.SemanticMarkup: START_MODULE_CONTRACT, START_MODULE_MAP, START_CONTRACT, START_BLOCK_*, and START_CHANGE_SUMMARY are load-bearing navigation and evidence.
Principles.PreserveMuya: Do not rewrite the Muya editor engine; modernize the shell and adapters around its established WYSIWYG behavior.
Principles.DocumentIntegrity: Opening, editing, saving, mode switching, import, export, and external reload must preserve user content or fail visibly without destructive fallback.
Principles.LocalFirstSecurity: File content, clipboard material, keys, and absolute home paths remain local and redacted; path and shell operations pass explicit security guards.
Principles.CompatibilityBeforeRewrite: Inspect and extend working upstream or shipped Mark behavior before adding replacement implementations.
Principles.ReleaseReproducibility: Version sources, release fixtures, tags, artifacts, updater metadata, and Homebrew delivery remain synchronized and mechanically verified.
Principles.VerificationFirstClass: Module commands, scenarios, markers, traces, fixtures, and phase gates are maintained with implementation and graph changes.
Principles.GovernedChangeLifecycle: New work starts with an approved GRACE 4 spec and plan. Legacy operational packets remain provenance and are not retroactive changes.
Principles.GpuSlotOne: Local inference uses one GPU engine at a time and follows the canonical local-AI preflight protocol before inference.

ArchitectureNotes.objective: Port Mark Text off abandoned Electron 18 + Vue 2 stack onto (A) modern Electron 30 + Vue 3 as intermediate v1.0, then (B) Tauri v2 + Rust as final v2.0, while merging 13 community PRs and delivering a Homebrew-installable, ad-hoc-signed macOS app.
ArchitectureNotes.non-goal: Do NOT rewrite muya. It has zero Electron coupling (verified by grep) and ports to WebView unchanged.
Do NOT engage with upstream marktext/marktext maintainers. This is an independent fork.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-1: PR #4001 (electron-vite refactor) conflicts with bugfix PRs — resolved by merge-order: bugfixes first, then #4001.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-2: muya in WKWebView may be slower than Chromium on large docs — benchmark gate at Phase-B1.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-3: All 6 native modules (keytar, chokidar, fontmanager-redux, native-keymap, vscode-ripgrep, @hfelix/electron-localshortcut) must be replaced in Phase B.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-4: electron-store → tauri-plugin-store schema migration is one-way and must preserve user prefs.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-5: NSSpellChecker has no existing Tauri plugin; custom objc2 FFI required for Phase-B3.
ArchitectureNotes.strategy: Hybrid two-phase: Phase A ships value quickly (bugfixes + Vue 3 + slim build) as v1.0; Phase B is the radical Tauri port as v2.0. Between phases, ~2 weeks user-stabilization window.

LegacyOperationalPackets.Disposition: Preserved as GRACE 3 communication-template provenance. Future execution, graph, verification, failure, and handoff state belongs in approved GRACE 4 change bundles and current projections.
